# AAVMC

> AAVMC is the Association of American Veterinary Medical Colleges, providing comprehensive learning resources, professional development, and member support for veterinary education.

AAVMC operates a learning platform offering pre-veterinary courses, leadership training, and exclusive member resources. The organization serves as a central hub for veterinary medical education and professional development through tools like AAVMC CONNECT, VCMAS APPLICATION PORTAL, and integrated support systems.

## Key Topics

- AAVMC CONNECT
- VCMAS APPLICATION PORTAL
- Pre-veterinary courses
- Veterinary education
- Leadership training
- Professional development
- Member resources
- Liaison CAS
- Zoho Desk
- Wellbeing
- Course catalog
- Learning platform
